summary: This is a sample 15-day Ayurvedic lifestyle plan designed for diabetes management. Your personalized plan will be generated based on your Prakriti assessment.

days.morning: Wake up at 6 AM. Drink warm water with lemon. Practice 15 minutes of gentle yoga (Surya Namaskar).
days.meals:
Breakfast: Steamed vegetables with whole grain roti (7:30 AM)
Lunch: Dal, brown rice, seasonal vegetables (12:30 PM)
Snack: Herbal tea with roasted chickpeas (4:00 PM)
Dinner: Light soup with vegetables (7:00 PM)
days.evening: Light walk for 20 minutes. Meditation for 10 minutes before bed. Sleep by 10 PM.
